entry.title: Still standing
entry.content: On the afternoon of April 14th, a hacker using a UK IP address exploited an out-of-date software package on one of 4chan’s servers, via a bogus PDF upload. With this entry point, they were eventually able to gain access to one of 4chan’s servers, including database access and access to our own administrative dashboard. entry.content: 4chan bandwidth was 3PB last month. 4chan doesn’t use amazon web services. But you can guess the price with it. $0.030 per GB 1000GB = 1TB 1000TB = 1PB $0.03 x 3,000,000(3PB) = $90,000 3PB is $90,000 per month by amazon web service. https://aws.amazon.com/cloudfront/pricing/
